appDescription: Voyadio plays live radio from around the world. Instead of a channel list, it drifts from station to station along a course the driver sets: a country, a language, or a kind of program.

function.name: DRIFT_NEXT_STATION
function.description: Move on to a live radio station from another place in the world, along the current drift course.

function.name: SET_DRIFT_COURSE
function.description: Change the drift course so the radio plays live stations from one country, in one language, or of one kind of program, and start playing.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the stations should broadcast from.

languageCode.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the stations should broadcast in.

programType.description: Kind of programs the stations should play.

function.name: SAVE_CURRENT_STATION
function.description: Save the radio station playing now to the user's favorite stations.
